cases.input: A repair records actual work and evidence against an order.
cases.expect: The event remains distinct from authorization.
cases.violates: A closed order never substitutes for an event.

cases.input: A component is replaced under a pinned continuity rule.
cases.expect: Membership episodes change without silent calibration transfer.
cases.violates: Component replacement closes and opens membership explicitly.

cases.input: A verifier corrects a resource actual.
cases.expect: A revision preserves the original record.
cases.violates: Corrections append and never erase original evidence.

cases.input: A closed work order is treated as proof of execution.
cases.violates: A closed order never substitutes for an event.

cases.input: Parent identity is preserved without a continuity rule.
cases.violates: Asset continuity follows a pinned local rule.
A component change that affects a measuring subsystem invalidates dependent fitness and never carries a calibration event, certificate or validity to the successor configuration.

cases.input: One maintenance event cites two authorizing work orders.
cases.violates: A maintenance event cites at most one authorizing work order.

cases.input: A WM-ACT-007 order is closed with zero maintenance events recorded against it.
cases.expect: The order remains valid and no maintenance event is inferred.
cases.violates: An authorizing work order may cite zero maintenance events, including after closure.

cases.input: A WM-MAT-008 observation record is registered as the maintenance event itself.
cases.violates: WM-MAT-008 observations and WM-ACT-034 assessments may be cited as evidence and never constitute event identity.

cases.input: componentChanges are recorded while continuityRuleRef and continuityRuleVersion are absent.
cases.violates: Asset continuity follows a pinned local rule.

cases.input: An accepted event is later voided by the verifier.
cases.expect: The voided state is appended and the original record, evidence bindings and performed interval remain intact.
cases.violates: Voiding, supersession and correction are appended states that preserve the original record, its evidence bindings and its performed interval.

cases.input: A correction overwrites the original resourceActuals value in place.
cases.violates: Corrections append and never erase original evidence.

cases.input: A measuring subsystem is replaced and the prior calibration event, certificate and validity window are bound to the successor configuration.
cases.violates: A component change that affects a measuring subsystem invalidates dependent fitness and never carries a calibration event, certificate or validity to the successor configuration.
